tools.title: Browserbase
tools.summary: Hosted headless browsers for agents and automation.

servers.name: Browserbase MCP (hosted)
servers.capabilities: Cloud browser sessions driven by Stagehand: start, navigate, act, observe, extract, end.

tools.notes: The API key goes in the browserbaseApiKey query parameter of the URL. The self-hostable repo browserbase/mcp-server-browserbase is archived and its npm package @browserbasehq/mcp-server-browserbase is deprecated.

tools.title: Chrome DevTools
tools.summary: Browser developer tools for debugging, profiling and auditing web pages in Chrome.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
servers.capabilities: Drives a live Chrome browser through DevTools and Puppeteer: navigation, input, console and network inspection, performance traces, Lighthouse audits.

tools.notes: Sends usage statistics to Google by default (disable with --no-usage-statistics) and may send trace URLs to the CrUX API (disable with --no-performance-crux).

tools.title: Obscura
tools.summary: Headless browser engine built for AI agents, driven over MCP or the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

servers.name: Obscura MCP server
servers.capabilities: Navigate, read a page as a snapshot or Markdown, click, fill forms, take screenshots and evaluate JavaScript in a headless browser.

tools.notes: Localhost and private networks are blocked by default: to test an application on your workstation, start it with OBSCURA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=1 in the environment. Page JavaScript runs inside the Obscura process, and the project recommends a container or a virtual machine. Use the standard build on your own applications and on sites whose terms allow automated access; the stealth build and proxies are outside what OpenGuildKit sets up. Also serves the Chrome DevTools Protocol with `obscura serve --port 9222` for Playwright (connectOverCDP) and Puppeteer.

tools.title: Puppeteer
tools.summary: Node.js library to control Chrome and Firefox over DevTools Protocol or WebDriver BiDi.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
servers.capabilities: Drives a live Chrome browser through DevTools and Puppeteer: navigation, input, console and network inspection, performance traces, Lighthouse audits.

tools.notes: Puppeteer's README points to chrome-devtools-mcp, a Puppeteer-based server. The old reference server @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer is archived and deprecated on npm; do not use it.
